Hotel prices in Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Africa, no star class listed: 68 hotels across booking sites

The 68 hotels in Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Africa for which Google Hotels listed no star class, in 30 cities. Each line shows the hotel's going rate and the lowest price we recorded across the booking sites Google Hotels listed, per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees, from its city's snapshot. Each hotel's page has every site's price. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

At 45 of the 68 hotels, a site was 5% or more below the going rate on its page (all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees); the sites lowest there most often: the hotel's own site (7 hotels), Booking.com and Vio.com (5 hotels each), Agoda (4 hotels). A tie counts for each site.

Other star classes in Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Africa: 5-star · 4-star · 3-star · 1- and 2-star. Every city we priced in Asia-Pacific, the Middle East and Africa.
